lines.en: But there are several things that last a very long time.
I hope you are one of them.
: Grasping at straws! Whichever ones we can reach!
: Curling our fingers around them like the necks of tiny birds and stripping them of their skin!
: Pressing our lips to the plastic and sucking. Sucking as if our life depends on it!
: But nothing ever finds its way into our mouths.
: Not a single drop of water, nor stray insect seeking moisture. Crawling in through the tube and down into your intestines.
: Turning your body into a home when home is nowhere else.
: And then dying because it's never able to find its way out.
: Hey, Yasu. Why aren’t you dressed in your swimsuit like everyone else?
: Why, because nightfall is just moments away.
: We were fortunate enough to have His Holiness intervene and provide us several hours of warmth, but his power can only do so much in the winter time.
: Once the sun is gone, he will slumber once more.
: And everything will go back to being a heaping pile of shit.
: Well, at least your religion is cool enough to let you swear.
: That aside, I guess it is about time to start thinking about lunch.
: I lost a few hours to an...interesting get together with Makoto, so I didn’t even realize that morning was over until just a few minutes ago.
: I lost a few hours when I fell asleep in my room, so I didn’t even realize that morning was over until just a few minutes ago.
: Yes. As I just said, I didn’t realize how quickly the morning went by and-
: Sensei, were you not listening to me?
: I said nightfall is just moments away.
: There will be no lunch until tomorrow, when all returns to form.
: Is your weird god just...skipping over the afternoon as payment for making it warm or something?
: No. And if his powers go away once night comes or whatever, why would he make night come sooner?
: The answer to that is simple.
: Because everything hurts a little less when you are asleep.
: King of all kings! Child of man!
: Show us how fleeting it is to be!
: O world! In our final moments, grant us the serenity to accept that your word is law!
: That all outcomes in all worlds flow into you! And in return, you into us!
: Wrapping around your feet and dragging you into his mouth?
: Only those fortunate enough will be swallowed whole- and as all I say is prophecy, all you see is true!
: All you feel is true! Your experiences!
: The [young_girls] you fill with your unblessed seed! Forever contaminating them until they elect to be cleansed!
: The same way I can fix them.
: Each and every day is a collection of time...but what do we do when time runs out?
: O...if only it were as simple as filling a room full of clocks so that time would last forever.
: Maybe then, we would understand how insignificant our existence is.
: I can not see the moon, nor would I be able to reach it if I could.
: But if my body ever became colossal, I would swallow it whole like a prescription pill.
: Not because I believe I need to be cured, but because those unwilling to search deep within themselves for the answer to everything-
: Those people do not deserve such beauty.
: Perhaps the reason I can’t see it is because the moon itself is unworthy of me.
As much as I want to say something witty right now, I think there might be an actual problem with Yasu.
It’s obviously not the first time she’s been this...emphatic about religion, but it’s the first time I’ve felt like she might actually do something dangerous.
What that would be, I have no idea.
But I can’t just let her stand out here in the dark, yelling things to herself.
Ugh. Time to be a real adult.
: Yasu, come on. Let’s go find Touka and the rest of the girls.
: I’m sure they’re all currently freaking out about the immediate switch to night, so you might be able to calm them down by...telling them about the...power or whatever.
: To everyone else, this will have been a normal day.
: Oh, okay. So I’m the only one who had to miss out on lunch. Thank you, mysterious lunch-hating god.
: Now, come on. We can’t just stand out here.
: Hear what? What are you talking about?
: Nightfall has already come and you’ve yet to leave your futon.
: If you are not feeling well, I would be happy to borrow this resort’s kitchen to make you soup.
: For the last time, Kendo Princess...soup isn’t going to make me feel better.
: If I’m dragging you down as well, feel free to go out and have fun with the rest of the girls.
: But...I don’t share the same bond with them that I do with you.
: I believe the best thing for me to do is remain by your side until you are feeling better.
: Well...you’re probably gonna be here for a while then. I’m not sure if this debuff is one that will come off so easily.
: Can I...at least get you a drink?
: Humans can go a surprisingly long time without food, but just several days without water is enough to kill a man.
: And while you are not a man, I believe the same rule applies to women.
: Feckin’ Hell. ‘Least my roommate will always be on my side.
: I just want her to...acknowledge me, you know?...
: I am having a hard time understanding your feelings for her. But if you are worried that she does not like you, I would disagree.
: The two of you are together rather often for characters with opposing viewpoints and backgrounds.
: If she truly did dislike you, I can’t imagine she would continue-
: I’m not talkin’ about the feckin’ backgrounds, Tsuneyo! I love her!
: I love her and she doesn’t love me! That’s all you need to know!
: I do not understand love or how it works...
: But I do understand that I would have struggled greatly without your help in getting adjusted to life outside of noodles.
: And because of that, I believe that anyone who does not return those precious feelings of yours is making a terrible mistake.
: I will go get you water and a bar of protein. Please at least have something to drink.
: Can you maybe just go for a walk or something and come back later? I promise I’ll be...a little better then...
: I just want some time to be by myself and get my mind off of things...
: Please do your best to get rid of your debuff.
: I will be near water if you need me.
: Is it really that late already?...
: I really have been in bed the entire day.
: Haven’t even logged in to do my dailies yet. Gonna be up all night at this rate.
: Stupid Rin. Making me cry for like the...millionth time instead of...coming over to cheer me up or something.
: Too wrapped up in some girl with...stupid hair to even realize that I like her.
: Just kidding. Otoha’s hair is nice. But she probably hasn’t even realized that Rin only dyed hers so that they could match.
: I should probably apologize to Otoha for flipping out on her.
: Oh, hey. I didn’t think you were awake.
: Have you seen my phone by any chance? I think I left it in here when I dropped by earlier.
: To meet up with Otoha and Nodoka, yeah. You were dead asleep, though, so you probably didn’t even realize it.
: I’ve actually been...here all day because of-
: Molly, come on. We can talk about our fight or whatever after the beach.
: I’ve gotta keep my mind clear tonight, and getting into this now would just make things worse.
: Have you seen my phone or not?
: What? Why are you looking at me like that?
: I’m...trying to figure out the best way to say this...
: Say what? Because that kind of makes me think it has nothing to do with my phone.
: Which then makes me think that it’s going to be about our argument and how we both pushed each other's buttons.
: And now I’m going to spiral into thinking about a whole bunch of stuff I’m trying to put off until after my plans tonight.
: I mean you’re acting weird by even your standards. And you’re kind of the queen of weirdness sooooo, that’s kind of saying a lot.
: Tell me more about...what you think of me...
: No one is going to come back here for a while, so...we can talk about...all kinds of stuff...
: Can I have my arm back, please?
: Why don’t you look at me like a normal girl?!
: Why do you get nervous around everyone except me?!
: Jesus, Molly! What the fuck is your problem?!
: I don’t have time to get nervous when I have to fucking wrestle a tiny Irish girl off of me!
: I don’t want to! I want you to...to cancel your plans! And spend time with me instead!
: Get the fuck away from me, dude! This is so weird!
It’s funny how love works sometimes.
Out of nowhere, you just start falling.
Then, before you even know it-
You wind up on the ground.
Not dead, but not entirely alive either.
In fact, the vast majority of falls wind up with something or someone getting damaged in some way.
And despite having her fall cushioned, I think we all know who took more damage from this one.
Love’s not only funny, but ironic.
Or, at least it is this time.
: Yeah! I can fucking see that! But you’re being a total creep about it and I have shit to do!
: Can’t you do it later? I need you right now.
: What in the everloving fuck are you on, dude?
: Molly...get the fuck off of me.
: I don’t know what you want, but-
: How do you not know? How much more obvious do I need to make it?
: Just kiss me and...and see that-
: And hey, guess what? I didn’t like it.
: And if you want to keep being my friend, you will get the fuck off of me right now.
: Molly. I don’t want to fucking hear it.
: I know what you’re going to say and...again...I don’t want to hear it.
When I am king, dilly, dilly
Who told you so, dilly, dilly
If you love me, dilly, dilly
: Rin! I’m sorry! For yelling at Otoha and...and for tackling you!
: And for being an all around bad friend tonight! But...I can’t help it!
: I just want you to be happy! That’s all!
: I don’t want this to make things weird! I want to take it all back!
: In fact, if there is literally anything I get, it’s this exact thing.
: And I really don’t like how you acted tonight. It was fucking creepy and totally unlike you.
: I’m such an idiot...I’m such an idiot...I’m such an idiot...
: Don’t...go beating yourself up about it...
: You did a shitty thing, but...you’re a good friend when you’re not...jumping on me and shit.
: I’m so sorry, Rin...I really am...Please please please please please don’t hate me...
: But...I think the two of us could probably use a little space for now...
: Oh my God...I’m sorry...I’m so, so sorry...
: Listen, I’m just gonna...go now. But it’ll be okay.
: I won’t tell anyone what happened and if anybody asks why we’re not talking or whatever, we can just...use the D&D thing as an excuse.
: Which...also makes a lot more sense now, by the way. So...sorry.
: That must have been a...really shitty position to be in.
: Well...DMing is a tough job as-is, so...
: Gonna need a...hell of a lot of it.
Landing on the ground and not having your insides splattered all over the cement means that you can still pick yourself back up and start walking again.
Probably not right away because of all of the bone fragments that would need to be removed-
And, who knows? Maybe you’ll need a new bionic leg or something like that.
But as long as you’re alive, you can keep on going.
